item.title: Ford–Geely Talks Reflect New Era of Trade-Driven Manufacturing
item.description: DEARBORN, MI—Ford Motor Co. and China’s Geely Auto are in preliminary discussions for a potential partnership that could see Ford’s excess production capacity in Europe used to build Geely vehicles, sources familiar with the talks told Reuters.

item.title: Tesla to End Model X, S Production, Convert Fremont Space for Optimus Robots,
item.description: FREMONT, Calif. — Tesla plans to end production of its Model S and Model X vehicles and convert part of its Fremont factory into a robot-manufacturing operation capable of producing up to 1 million Optimus humanoid robots per year, CEO Elon Musk said during the company’s fourth-quarter financial report.

item.title: Rivian Plans to Build Next-Gen EV With Advanced Production Technology
item.description: NORMAL, IL—Rivian Automotive Inc. will assemble its much-anticipated R2 on a "technologically advanced production lie that runs on smart and connected digital systems."

item.title: ‘Connected Worker’ Software Improves Training
item.description: The Augmentir connected worker platform is designed to help manufacturing and service teams improve operations, close skills gaps, capture tribal knowledge, and drive continuous improvement efforts.

item.title: Hyundai to Invest $86.7 Billion to Expand Robotics, AI Capabilities
item.description: SEOUL, South Korea — Hyundai Motor Group said it will invest $86.7 billion through 2030 to become a global leader in robotics and physical artificial intelligence. The plan includes the creation of a dedicated robotics training complex in Georgia.

item.title: Allonic Raises $7.2M for Automated Platform to Build Advanced Robot Parts
item.description: BUDAPEST, Hungary — Allonic, a robotics manufacturing startup founded in Hungary with a joint U.S. headquarters, has raised $7.2 million in pre-seed funding to develop an automated production platform aimed at speeding the manufacture of advanced robotic hardware.

item.title: Robot Automates Machine Tending
item.description: Business has been good at TL Aerotek Inc., with orders flowing in faster than owner, Tai Le, could fill them. He wanted to keep up with accelerating demand and continue building his business, but he didn’t want to deal with labor uncertainty. Looking for a solution, Tai consulted long-time supplier, Expand Machinery, a family-owned business in Chatsworth, CA, that builds machine tool systems.

item.title: New Technology for Installing Threaded Inserts
item.description: Impulse heat staking simplifies installation of brass inserts by generating heat only when needed and keeping the cycle consistent from part to part. Real-time depth verification adds straightforward confirmation of final insert depth and insert presence.

item.title: ASSEMBLY Audible: Meaghan Elwell on Engaging Frontline Workers and Building Human-Centered Manufacturing
item.description: On paper, many manufacturing facilities are high-performing operations, but research shows that even in the most well-run environments, frontline workers don’t always feel engaged, empowered or confident in their day-to-day performance. So where are manufacturers getting the workplace right, and where are they falling short when it comes to how employees actually experience the plant?

item.title: Zoomlion Says Smart Factory Model Cuts Heavy Equipment Changeover Time to Zero
item.description: CHANGSHA, China — Zoomlion said it has cut excavator manufacturing cycle time to 6.5 days and achieved a production pace of one machine every six minutes by building a shared smart factory system designed to handle high-mix, low-volume heavy equipment production.
